description:
Make scenario-to-desktop participate directly in the canonical approval-gating flow owned by deployment-manager.

That includes using build provenance consistently, creating or updating pending approval state where appropriate, surfacing blocked release conditions in scenario-specific UI/CLI flows, and supporting wait/resume style behavior without duplicating approval storage or business rules.
name: scenario-to-desktop-approval-gate-integration
title: Integrate Scenario To Desktop With Canonical Approval Gates
